source_name: АМКУ — Державний реєстр суб'єктів господарювання, притягнутих до відповідальності (procurement blacklist)
why_relevant: The formal state register of entities barred from procurement for anticompetitive concerted actions — the 'чорний список АМКУ'. Directly flags which suppliers are excluded, and is a strong secondary pointer to affiliated bidder clusters.

source_name: АМКУ — повідомлення щодо оприлюднення рішень адмінколегії з розгляду скарг
why_relevant: Official notice explaining WHERE and in what form complaint decisions are published (Prozorro electronic system vs AMCU site) — the key document for designing a reliable collection pipeline for the appeals stream.

source_name: Mission of Ukraine to the EU — EU public procurement market guide for Ukrainian exporters
why_relevant: Ukrainian-language official explainer of how Ukrainian firms (incl. fintech/IT/financial services) access EU tenders via TED and the WTO GPA (Ukraine acceded 18 May 2016). Gives the local terminology and the legal basis for Ukrainian entities appearing as awardees on foreign portals — the core of this cell.

source_name: Open Data Toolkit — «Як виявляти корупцію у публічних закупівлях»
why_relevant: Practical Ukrainian-language manual on detecting procurement corruption from open data — codifies the exact heuristics watchdogs apply, in local terminology. Directly reusable as a screening ruleset for banking/payments tenders.

source_name: Ministry of Economy of Ukraine — donor procurement rule announcements
why_relevant: Official confirmations of which donors have approved Prozorro use and under which constructor-based donor procedure; also announces which ministries will channel donor money through Prozorro. Determines where to look for a given lender's UA notices.

source_name: Law of Ukraine 'Про публічні закупівлі' on zakon.rada.gov.ua
why_relevant: Defines who counts as a 'Замовник' — decisive for this cell, because Sense Bank and PrivatBank have argued differing scopes of obligation. Determines how much of each state bank's spend is legally forced into the public record versus handled on its own portal.

source_name: Diia Business — довідник підприємця: асоціація членів платіжних систем ЄМА
why_relevant: State-run business handbook entry describing EMA and its role; a government-side pointer that helps validate association identity and can list other sectoral associations.

source_name: ua-region.com.ua company record for ТОВ "ЗАКУПКИ.ПРОМ.УА" (EDRPOU 40283641)
why_relevant: Demonstrates the resolution path from marketplace brand -> legal entity -> EDRPOU code -> registry data (directors, KVED, address). Needed to link marketplace operators to their corporate groups and to detect ownership changes in the aggregator market itself.

source_name: YouControl 'Аналіз тендерів' (Tender Analysis) free tool
why_relevant: Free one-click check of all participants in a given procurement, consolidating tender info and risk flags. Fast triage route from a single banking-equipment tender to the full participant set, which then seeds supplier enumeration.

source_name: Sense Bank acquiring help-centre — POS terminal models used by the bank
why_relevant: Demand-side page that reveals supply: the bank publicly lists the exact terminal models it deploys (Verifone vx520/VX200T/vx675/V240M, PAX Q80/S920, Ingenico Move 2500, Desk 2600). Equivalent pages at other acquirers let one reconstruct each bank's hardware vendor mix without any tender document.

source_name: Infobox Prozorro — official knowledge base article on procurement monitoring tools
why_relevant: Prozorro's own knowledge base enumerates the monitoring instruments available (public and paid analytics modules, third-party services). An authoritative, low-noise pointer for validating which monitoring services are considered legitimate parts of the ecosystem — and for the correct Ukrainian terminology to use in further queries.

source_name: Prozorro Infobox — Ukraine Facility procurement rules explainer
why_relevant: Explains, in Ukrainian, how EU Ukraine Facility money is procured (national law plus Framework Agreement requirements) — i.e. exactly which EU-funded contracts land in Prozorro rather than TED. Critical for de-duplicating and for knowing where NOT to look.

source_name: Prozorro Infobox — supplier participation guidance (infobox.prozorro.org)
why_relevant: Official knowledge base explaining buyer/supplier roles, procedure types and the wartime 'відкриті торги з особливостями' regime — needed to interpret state-bank buyer records correctly (e.g. why auctions are currently absent).

source_name: Infobox Prozorro — NBU procurement practice guidance and case articles
why_relevant: Prozorro's own editorial channel published NBU-specific procurement practice notes, revealing how the central bank structures its tenders (procedure types, exemptions, wartime practice) — essential for building correct collection filters.

source_name: MDB harmonisation of procurement in Ukraine (World Bank press release, Oct 2023)
why_relevant: The founding document of the CEB/EBRD/EIB/World Bank harmonised approach for UA public-sector investment procurement. Defines the rule regime and thresholds that determine whether a donor-financed UA contract appears on a lender portal or in Prozorro — the routing logic this whole cell depends on.

source_name: Power Payment Summit: Ukraine–Europe Bridge (ProMoney / PSM7 announcement)
why_relevant: Summit agenda (SEPA readiness, instant payments/A2A, card future, open banking, payment security) is a direct read on the infrastructure programmes UA banks and PSPs will fund and tender in the next 12-24 months.

source_name: НАБУ — новини/анонси заходів (association news & event announcements)
why_relevant: NABU announces and co-brands industry events; the announcement pages name organisers, sponsors and thematic focus (payment infrastructure, open banking, AI), revealing which modernisation programmes banks are preparing to buy.

source_name: OTP Group — ESG guidelines in procurement (PDF) & Partner Code of Ethics
why_relevant: OTP Group's procurement-facing ESG rulebook plus a separate Partner Code of Ethics setting minimum standards for suppliers, sponsored partners and other counterparties across group members, including OTP Bank Ukraine. Defines the qualification bar a vendor must clear before OTP Ukraine's tender process even starts.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International — Group Supplier Code of Conduct (PDF, 08/2025)
why_relevant: Binding contractual annex for anyone supplying any RBI Group entity, including Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine. Sets COP21 climate alignment, human-rights and fair-competition obligations, and forbids sharing RBI procurement information with third parties — the last clause directly constrains what suppliers and therefore intelligence collection can expect to see. Dated version (08/2025) makes it trackable.

source_name: Transparency International Defence & Security — 'Six Red Flags' Ukraine
why_relevant: Concrete, Ukraine-specific enumeration of the most frequent procurement corruption risks — the checklist a watchdog applies when it flags a tender. Transferable to banking/payments equipment tenders even though authored for defence.

source_name: Ukraine Fintech Week (UAFIC) — programme, donors and partner institutions
why_relevant: Post-event write-ups name the donor/IFI backers (IFC, World Bank Group, SECO) and the themes they fund. Donor-funded programmes very often precede public tenders for banking/payments modernisation — a strong pre-tender signal.

entity_name: UNIAN / незалежна розслідувальна преса про неконкурентні тендери ОВА
source_name: UNIAN / незалежна розслідувальна преса про неконкурентні тендери ОВА
why_relevant: Investigative reporting quantifies the share of oblast-administration purchases made non-competitively (reported as 92.3% in one oblast). Such pieces reveal supplier networks and contract substance that the formal record understates.
